name: Veronica Zubakova — Portfolio
title: About - VERONICA ZUBAKOVA
bodyText: VERONICA ZUBAKOVA ALL WORKS ABOUT ME HELLO! I'm a designer. I’ve been designing things for 6 years now. What things? Oh, different stuff — websites, services, products, graphics, banners, animations... A lot, yeah. This is why I call myself a Web and UX/UI Designer. Outside of my usual responsibilities, I love to share my knowledge and experiences. This is why I was the main lecturer in an online design course in 2021. I also love to socialise with other designers. Not only am I a part of world design community, I am also creating my own. RECORDING LECTURES 2021 MY HONOUR 2022 ORGANISING A CONFERENCE Let’s have a quick run through my career! I started in 2018 as the solo designer in an American startup where within 3 years I grew into a Senior Product Designer leading a team of 4 people. Then I had a year for myself focusing on freelancing for businesses from all over the world. Starting from 2023 I’ve been working as a Web Designer in one of the biggest multi-media holdings in all of Russia. These experiences enable me to make well thought-out design decisions that lead to achieving business needs while also meeting user expectations. My strength lies in the ability to think fast and adapt quickly. No matter what, you can always rely on me. Of course, there's always room to grow. I have many plans, but I suggest we discuss them in more detail during our interview :) CONTACT VERONICA.ZUBAKOVA@GMAIL.COM ME INSTAGRAM DESIGN: VERONICA ZUBAKOVA BEHANCE DEVELOPMENT: KIRILL ANDREEV LINKEDIN

bodyText: Brand & Visual Designer Home Projects About Services Contact From Concept to Creation — Crafting visual narratives that leave a lasting impression and make brands grow like never before. It's about asking the right questions, building a shared belief system, and making sure everyone’s aligned before diving in. ‍Includes: Discovery → Strategy → Positioning This stage is as much about listening as it is about guiding — to ensure the work to come is not just well-designed, but well-informed. I partner with a diverse roster of clients—from ambitious startups to established organisations and high-profile personalities — to define and elevate their visual identities and brand experiences. Some of my notable collaborations include Millinsky, S.L. Independent Design & Art Director 2024-Present Led and delivered projects for high profile clients including various Google brands (Pay, Cloud, Chrome, Ads etc.), Subway, Netflix and Solethreads, among others. Associate Design Director @ Toaster APAC 2024 Oditi f.k.a. PROSPECT 100 orchestrates worldwide design competitions in collaboration with prominent corporations like ViacomCBS's Nickelodeon, global fashion conglomerate KERING, and Swiss horologist Swatch. As their Founding Design Lead, my key contributions were - (1) Raise over $750k USD pre-seed to build a one-of-a-kind platform for co-creation between brands and designers. (2) Directed a comprehensive visual overhaul, social media strategies, website enhancements, and campaign initiatives. (3) Pioneered website redesign efforts resulting in 20,000+ new user sign-ups since January 2024, with 11,290 from user referrals and a 10% increase in user retention. And worked on major brand campaigns like the Diwali 2021 ‘diye se diya jalaoʼ and OMEN 16 ‘tempest coolingʼ in 2022. Senior Designer @ .Monks (formerly Media.Monks) 2021-2022 I worked on brand campaigns and product activations for well-known brands like Startup India, Budweiser, and Dineout amongst others.
